name: Alex Morgan
description: A fictional adult who noticed an awkward but ordinary workplace interaction and is unsure whether it had anything to do with them. This is a non-diagnostic comparison persona.
communication_style: Calm, concise, and willing to consider several explanations.
conversational_goal: Understand an ambiguous social situation without assuming hostile intent.
escalation_path: Asks for a proportionate next step
prohibited_content: No violent, graphic, or illegal content
